question: Does the common degree-four H=(Z/2)^2 lift retain character/Prym information beyond the base exact-W condition, and can the exact deck-translate intersection data be Fourier-resolved into characterwise Rosati constraints?

parent_05w.exact_use: Full abelian H-torsor cohomology is flexible once the exact-W condition is satisfied; the selected next view is the H-character/Prym decomposition of the common lift.

ex1_05h_source_note.exact_use: S0=(X(8)xX(8))/diag(H), q:S0->C2xC2 is finite etale degree four; D0^2=3874 and D0.uD0=3892, D0.vD0=4020, D0.uvD0=4020; normalization D has projections of degrees 105 and 81.

v4_quotient.exact_use: Z=X(8) has genus five and Z->C2 is connected finite etale of degree four with free H=(Z/2)^2 action; C2 has genus two.

relative_v4.exact_use: For an actual carrier the two pullbacks f105^*Z and f81^*Z are isomorphic H-torsors, so their common connected degree-four lift Dtilde carries two H-equivariant maps to Z.

rosati_source_note.exact_use: For a correspondence of bidegree (d1,d2), the retained self-pairing is 2*d1*d2-C^2=Tr(T^dagger T); bilinear cross-pairing is obtained by polarization.

rosati_repair.exact_use: Downstairs trivial-character Rosati trace is exactly sigma(Gamma)=1204, Q(T)=602. This provides the normalization check for the Fourier split.

common_lift.Dtilde_to_D: connected finite etale H-cover of degree four

cross_rosati.operator_interpretation: If S is the H-equivariant correspondence endomorphism on J(Z), polarization of the retained Rosati self-pairing gives sigma_k=Tr(S^dagger k^* S)=Tr(k^* S^dagger S).
cross_rosati.H_equivariance_reason: Dtilde0 is invariant under diagonal H, hence S commutes with H.

character_fourier_split.downstairs_check: trivial-character trace 1204 equals the retained downstairs Rosati trace
character_fourier_split.labeling_firewall: The multiset is exact. The current retained package does not identify which of the three nonzero exact-W character lines carries the distinguished value 274 without an additional deck-generator/character-line adapter.

prym_dimensions.reason: For a connected etale V4 cover of a genus-two curve, projection-formula character decomposition gives the invariant canonical forms from C2 and one canonical form for each nontrivial two-torsion character; dimensions sum to genus(Z)=5.

forced_prym_endomorphism_degrees.principle: On an elliptic Prym factor stable under S, the Rosati trace on H1 of S_chi^dagger S_chi is twice the degree of the restricted endomorphism.
forced_prym_endomorphism_degrees.degree_9_has_trivial_integer_model: [3] has degree 9 on every elliptic curve
forced_prym_endomorphism_degrees.interpretation: Any actual carrier forces one distinguished Prym character to support an endomorphism of degree 137, while the other two support degree 9. This is a genuinely stronger invariant than the base exact-W equality, but no exclusion is legal until End(P_chi) for the fixed X(8) Pryms is source-locked.

decision.reopen_condition: Further pruning requires either proving degree 137 is impossible in at least one forced Prym elliptic endomorphism ring, or an exact deck-generator-to-W-line adapter that couples the distinguished character to one or more of the residues 73,97,235.

next_route.selection_reason: 05X converts the previously qualitative Prym idea into the exact forced degree multiset {137,9,9}. The closest possible exclusion is now a fixed-X(8) elliptic endomorphism-ring norm test, followed by alignment of the unique large character with the three retained W-lines.
